basis: Andrew, 27 Oct 2026, on the Coates forklifts on contract 9961976 (all at $0 on Baseplan (8)): asked whether a forklift was off-hired earlier; the branch's delivery dockets show 1247787 (Forklift Rough Terrain 2.5t, switchable 2WD/4WD) out 14 Sep (26058104), back in 18 Sep (26083950, line 25 Returned, term 17 Sep), AT009 (Forklift Rough Terrain 2.5t, no fleet number, line 34) out 17 Sep (26083924) to The Esplanade, and 1247787 out again 20 Oct to Macintosh Island Park (26142467, line 35). Our record had T0005 on site from 14 Sep with 1247787 throughout and no AT009. Andrew: "Add the forklifts as you said. I will need to find out rates". So AT009 is added as EQ0007 from 17 Sep on NVAC, and T0005 carries a note of 1247787's return and second trip; rates to come from Andrew.
